title: Markdown blog loader and post templates
description: web/lib/blog.ts reads markdown at build time. Category is the folder. Frontmatter: title, date, description, ogHeadline, ogTagline, optional draft. Newest first. Drafts excluded. node:test in web/lib/blog.test.ts. Empty updates/ and agent-zoo/ folders. [slug] routes with generateStaticParams. Shared post chrome. No first posts.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text: Removed placeholder slug. [slug] routes deferred until first post; factory in blog-post-page.tsx.
